description: This file sets up an Express.js server application, configuring middleware for CORS, Swagger UI documentation, route mounting, and error handling.

methods.name: app.use(cors({...}))
methods.description: Configures and applies CORS middleware to handle cross-origin requests with specified options.

methods.name: app.set('trust proxy', true)
methods.description: Instructs Express to trust the proxy headers, useful when deploying behind a proxy or load balancer.

methods.name: app.use('/docs', swaggerUi.serve, ...)
methods.description: Sets up Swagger UI to serve API documentation at /docs, with dynamic server URL based on request.

methods.name: app.use(express.json())
methods.description: Middleware to parse incoming JSON request bodies.

methods.name: app.use('/', routes)
methods.description: Mounts route handlers from an external module at root path.

methods.name: app.use((err, req, res, next) => {...})
methods.description: Error handling middleware that logs errors and responds with a 500 status.
